'''Cammel Atarul''' was an investigator for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who worked on [[Tinnel IV/Legends|Tinnel IV]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Quanta sector/Legends|Quanta sector]]. Atarul was tasked with investigating a theft at the estate of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod/Legends|Tiaan Jerjerrod]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
